segments.sn3.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato hoti.
segments.sn3.8:1.3: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.8:1.4: “atthi nu kho te, mallike, kocañño attanā piyataro”ti?
segments.sn3.8:1.5: “Natthi kho me, mahārāja, kocañño attanā piyataro.
segments.sn3.8:1.6: Tuyhaṃ pana, mahārāja, atthañño koci attanā piyataro”ti?
segments.sn3.8:1.7: “Mayhampi kho, mallike, natthañño koci attanā piyataro”ti.
segments.sn3.8:2.1: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo pāsādā orohitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.8:2.2: “idhāhaṃ, bhante, mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.sn3.8:2.3: ‘atthi nu kho te, mallike, kocañño attanā piyataro’ti?
segments.sn3.8:2.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhante, mallikā devī maṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.8:2.5: ‘natthi kho me, mahārāja, kocañño attanā piyataro.
segments.sn3.8:2.6: Tuyhaṃ pana, mahārāja, atthañño koci attanā piyataro’ti?
segments.sn3.8:2.7: Evaṃ vuttāhaṃ, bhante, mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.sn3.8:2.8: ‘mayhampi kho, mallike, natthañño koci attanā piyataro”ti.
segments.sn3.8:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –

lines: Aṭṭhame atthi nu kho te malliketi kasmā pucchati?

Ayaṃ kira mallikā duggatamālākārassa dhītā, ekadivasaṃ āpaṇato pūvaṃ gahetvā “mālārāmaṃ gantvāva khādissāmī”ti gacchantī paṭipathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivāraṃ bhagavantaṃ bhikkhācāraṃ pavisantaṃ disvā pasannacittā taṃ bhagavato adāsi.
Bhagavā tattha nisīditvā taṃ pūvaṃ paribhuñjitvā mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
Thero “imissā, bhante, ko vipāko bhavissatī”ti pucchi.
Ānanda, ajjesā tathāgatassa paṭhamabhojanaṃ adāsi, ajjeva kosalarañño aggamahesī bhavissatīti.
Taṃdivasameva ca rājā kāsigāme bhāgineyyena yuddhena parājito palāyitvā nagaraṃ āgacchanto mālārāmaṃ pavisitvā balakāyassa āgamanaṃ āgamesi.
So tāya vatte pasīditvā taṃ antepūraṃ atihārāpetvā taṃ aggamahesiṭṭhāne ṭhapesi.
“mayā imissā duggatakulassa dhītuyā mahantaṃ issariyaṃ dinnaṃ, yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ puccheyyaṃ ‘ko te piyo’ti?
Sā ‘tvaṃ me, mahārāja, piyo’ti vatvā puna maṃ pucchissati.
Iti so aññamaññaṃ vissāsajananatthaṃ sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ kathento pucchati.
Sā pana devī paṇḍitā buddhupaṭṭhāyikā dhammupaṭṭhāyikā saṅghupaṭṭhāyikā mahāpaññā, tasmā evaṃ cintesi –
Rājā tāya sarasena kathitattā nivattituṃ alabhanto sayampi saraseneva kathetvā “sakāraṇaṃ idaṃ, tathāgatassa naṃ ārocessāmī”ti gantvā bhagavato ārocesi.
Evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresanti yathā ekassa attā piyo, evaṃ paresaṃ puthusattānampi attā piyoti attho.
Pucchākāraṇaṃ codetvā samudayato paṭṭhāya dassetuṃ “ayaṃ kira mallikā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Mālārāmaṃ gantvāti attano pitu mālārāmaṃ rakkhaṇatthañceva avasesapupphaggahaṇatthañca gantvā.
So kira gāmo mahākosalarājena attano dhītuyā patigharaṃ gacchantiyā pupphamūlatthāya dinno, taṃnimittaṃ.
Nivattitunti tassā dhammatāya nivattituṃ tassā vacanaṃ paṭikkhipituṃ.
